import json,datetime
d=json.load(open('positions.json'))
f=lambda t:datetime.datetime.utcfromtimestamp(t/1000).strftime('%d %H:%M')
eq=7.0
for p in sorted([p for p in d if p['status']=='closed'],key=lambda p:p['t_out']):
    eq+=p['pnl_usd']
    print(p['id'],p['sym'][:-4],p['side'][0],p.get('rule','watch'),'in',f(p['t_in']),'out',f(p['t_out']),p['reason'],p['net_pct'],p['pnl_usd'],'R',p['r_mult'],'mfe',p['mfe_pct'],'mae',p['mae_pct'],'eq',round(eq,3))
"; grep -n 'equity\|def snapshot\|start' pos.py | head -30
